original: yatrāntarmukhatayā pratilomapariṇāme prakṛtilīne cetasi sattāmātramavabhāti sāasmitā
analyzed: yatra antar mukha tayā pratiloma pariṇāme prakṛti līne cetasi sattā mātram avabhāti sā a asmitā

analyzed: asmin eva samādhau ye kṛta paritoṣāḥ param paramātmānam puruṣam na paśyanti teṣām cetasi sva kāraṇe layam upāgate prakṛti layāḥ iti ucyante

vṛttiḥ viramyate anena iti virāmaḥ vitarka ādi cintā tyāgaḥ

original: tatra yā kācidvṛttirullasati tasyā neti netīti nairantaryeṇa paryudasanaṃ virāmapratyayābhyāsaḥ

saṃskāra śeṣaḥ anyaḥ tad vilakṣaṇaḥ ayam asamprajñātaḥ iti arthaḥ
na tatra kiñcid vedyam
asamprajñātaḥ nirbījaḥ samādhiḥ

original: iha caturvidhaścittasya pariṇāmaḥ --- vyutthānaṃ samādhiprārambha ekāgratā nirodhaśca

niruddha aikāgrate ca paryanta bhūmī

vīryam utsāhaḥ
smṛtiḥ anubhūta asampramoṣaḥ
samādhiḥ ekāgra tā

original: tatra śraddhāvato vīryaṃ jāyate yogaviṣaya utsāhavān bhavati

analyzed: sa tīvraḥ yeṣām adhimātra upāyānām teṣām āsannaḥ samādhi lābhaḥ samādhi phalam ca āsannam bhavati
śīghram eva sampadyate iti arthaḥ

original: vṛttiḥ --- tebhya upāyebhyo mṛdvādibhedabhinnebhya upāyavatāṃ viśeṣo bhavati
analyzed: vṛttiḥ tebhyaḥ upāyebhyaḥ mṛdu ādi bheda bhinnebhyaḥ upāyavatām viśeṣaḥ bhavati
mṛduḥ madhyaḥ adhimātraḥ iti upāya bhedāḥ
te pratyekam mṛdu saṃvega madhya saṃvega tīvra saṃvega bhedāt tridhā

original: tadbhedena ca nava yogino bhavanti --- mṛdūpāyo mṛdusaṃvego madhyasaṃvegastīvrasaṃvegaśca
analyzed: tad bhedena ca nava yoginaḥ bhavanti mṛdu upāyaḥ mṛdu saṃvegaḥ madhya saṃvegaḥ tīvra saṃvegaḥ ca

adhimātra upāyaḥ mṛdu saṃvegaḥ madhya saṃvegaḥ tīvra saṃvegaḥ ca

vṛttiḥ īśvaraḥ vakṣyamāṇa lakṣaṇaḥ

original: tatra praṇidhānaṃ bhaktiviśeṣo viśiṣṭamupāsanaṃ sarvakriyāṇāṃ tatrārpaṇam
analyzed: tatra praṇidhānam bhakti viśeṣaḥ viśiṣṭam upāsanam sarva kriyāṇām tatra arpaṇam
viṣaya sukha ādikam phalam an icchan sarvāḥ kriyāḥ tasmin parama gurau arpayati
tad praṇidhānam samādheḥ tad phala lābhasya ca prakṛṣṭaḥ upāyaḥ
īśvarasya praṇidhānāt samādhi lābhaḥ iti uktam

original: tatreśvarasya svarūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ prabhāvaṃ vācakamupāsanākramaṃ tatphalaṃ ca krameṇa vaktumāha ---
analyzed: tatra īśvarasya svarūpam pramāṇam prabhāvam vācakam upāsanā kramam tad phalam ca krameṇa vaktum āha
kleśa karma vipāka āśayaiḥ aparāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣa viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ
samādhi 24
vṛttiḥ kliśnanti iti kleśāḥ avidyā ādayaḥ vakṣyamāṇāḥ
vihita niṣiddha vyāmiśra rūpāṇi karmāṇi
vipacyante iti vipākāḥ karma phalāni jāti āyuḥ bhogāḥ
ā phala vipākāt cittabhūmau śerate iti āśayaḥ vāsanā ākhya saṃskāraḥ
taiḥ aparāmṛṣṭaḥ triṣu api kāleṣu na saṃspṛṣṭaḥ

original: puruṣaviśeṣoanyebhyaḥ puruṣebhyo viśiṣyate iti viśeṣa īśvaraḥ īśanaśīla icchāmātreṇa sakalajagaduddharaṇakṣamaḥ
analyzed: puruṣa viśeṣaḥ anyebhyaḥ puruṣebhyaḥ viśiṣyate iti viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ īśana śīlaḥ icchā mātreṇa sakala jagat uddharaṇa kṣamaḥ

original: yadyapi sarveṣāmātmaṇāṃ kleśādisparśo nāsti tathāpi cittagatāsteṣāmupadiśyante
analyzed: yadi api sarveṣām ātmaṇām kleśa ādi sparśaḥ na asti tathā api citta gatāḥ teṣām upadiśyante
yathā yoddhṛ gataḥ jaya parājayau svāminaḥ

original: asya tu triṣvapi kāleṣu tathāvidhoapi kleśādiparāmarśo nāsti
analyzed: asya tu triṣu api kāleṣu tathāvidhaḥ api kleśa ādi parāmarśaḥ na asti
atas sa vilakṣaṇaḥ eva bhagavān īśvaraḥ
tasya ca tathāvidham aiśvaryam anādeḥ sattva utkarṣāt
tasya sattva utkarṣasya prakṛṣṭāt jñānāt eva
na ca anayoḥ jñāna aiśvaryayoḥ itaretara āśraya tvam paraspara anapekṣa tvāt

original: te dve jñānaiśvarye īśvarasattve vartamāne anādibhūte tena tathāvidhena sattvena tasyānādireva sambandhaḥ
analyzed: te dve jñāna aiśvarye īśvara sattve vartamāne anādi bhūte tena tathāvidhena sattvena tasya anādiḥ eva sambandhaḥ
prakṛti puruṣa saṃyoga viyogayoḥ īśvara icchā vyatirekeṇa anupapatteḥ

original: yathetareṣāṃ prāṇināṃ sukhaduḥkhamohātmakatayā pariṇataṃ cittaṃ nirmale sāttvike dharmānuprakhye pratisaṅkrāntaṃ cicchāyāsaṃkrānte saṃvedyaṃ bhavati naivamīśvarasya
analyzed: yathā itareṣām prāṇinām sukha duḥkha moha ātmaka tayā pariṇatam cittam nirmale sāttvike dharma anuprakhye pratisaṅkrāntam cit chāyā saṃkrānte saṃvedyam bhavati na evam īśvarasya

original: tasya kevala eva sāttvikaḥ pariṇāma utkarṣavānanādisambandhena bhogyatayā vyavasthitaḥ
analyzed: tasya kevalaḥ eva sāttvikaḥ pariṇāmaḥ utkarṣavān anādi sambandhena bhogya tayā vyavasthitaḥ
atas puruṣa antara vilakṣaṇa tayā saḥ eva īśvaraḥ
mukta ātmanān tu punar punar kleśa ādi yogaḥ taiḥ taiḥ śāstra uktaiḥ upāyaiḥ nivartitaḥ
asya punar sarvadā eva tathāvidha tvāt na muktātma tulya tvam
na ca īśvarāṇām aneka tvam
teṣām tulya tve bhinna abhiprāya tvāt kāryasya eva anupapatteḥ

original: utkarṣāpakarṣayuktatve ya evotkṛṣṭaḥ sa eveśvarastatraiva kāṣṭhāprāptatvādaiśvaryasya
analyzed: utkarṣa apakarṣa yuktatve yaḥ eva utkṛṣṭaḥ saḥ eva īśvaraḥ tatra eva kāṣṭhā prāptatvāt aiśvaryasya
evam īśvarasya svarūpam abhidhāya pramāṇam āha
tatra niratiśayam sārvajñya bījam

original: vṛttiḥ --- tasmin bhagavati sarvajñatvasya yadbījamatītānāgatādigrahaṇasyālpatvaṃ mahatvaṃ ca mūlatvādbījamiva bījam
analyzed: vṛttiḥ tasmin bhagavati sarvajñatvasya yat bījam atīta anāgata ādi grahaṇasya alpatvam mahatvam ca mūla tvāt bījam iva bījam
tat tatra niratiśayam kāṣṭhām prāptam
dṛṣṭā hi alpatva mahatva ādīnām dharmāṇām sa atiśayānām kāṣṭhā prāptiḥ
yathā paramāṇau alpa tvasya ākāśe parama maha tvasya
evam jñāna ādayaḥ api citta dharmāḥ tāratamyena paridṛśyamānāḥ kvacid niratiśaya tām āsādayanti

original: yadyapi sāmānyamātreanumānasya paryavasitatvānna viśeṣāvagatiḥ sambhavati tathāpi śāstrādasya sarvajñatvādayo viśeṣā avagantavyāḥ
analyzed: yadi api paryavasita tvāt na viśeṣa avagatiḥ sambhavati tathā api śāstrāt asya sarvajña tva ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ avagantavyāḥ

original: tasya svaprayojanābhāve kathaṃ prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ saṃyogaviyogāvāpādayatīti nāaaśaṅkanīyaṃ tasya kāruṇikatvādbhūtānugraha eva prayojanam
analyzed: tasya sva prayojana abhāve katham prakṛti puruṣayoḥ saṃyoga viyogau āpādayati iti na a aśaṅkanīyam tasya kāruṇika tvāt bhūta anugrahaḥ eva prayojanam
kalpa pralaya mahāpralayeṣu niḥśeṣān saṃsāriṇaḥ uddhariṣyāmi iti tasya adhyavasāyaḥ

evam īśvarasya pramāṇam abhidhāya prabhāvam āha
sa pūrveṣām api guruḥ kālena anavacchedāt
